description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Engineer (Data Platform) based in the United States. 

 The Data Engineer will play a key role in building, maintaining, and evolving reliable data infrastructure that supports business and analytics needs. You will design and optimize data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring that production workflows remain efficient, scalable, and dependable. Working closely with analysts and fellow engineers, you will translate business requirements into maintainable data solutions while improving data quality and system performance. The role involves hands-on work across SQL, Python, cloud data services, and distributed processing technologies. You will also use AI and LLM tools as part of your engineering workflow, applying critical judgment to their outputs. This is an opportunity to take end-to-end ownership in a collaborative, fast-moving environment and deliver measurable improvements to data reliability, performance, and cost.

Accountabilities
 

 
 Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain data ingestion and ETL/ELT transformation pipelines that support business operations and analytical use cases.



 
 Production Reliability and Support: Maintain and improve existing production pipelines by monitoring performance, troubleshooting issues, resolving incidents, and strengthening workflow reliability.



 
 SQL and Performance Optimization: Optimize analysts' SQL queries and underlying data transformations to improve execution speed, resource utilization, and overall cloud infrastructure costs.



 
 Data Quality and Documentation: Establish and improve data quality checks, testing practices, and technical documentation to ensure trustworthy and maintainable data assets.



 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with analysts and engineering colleagues to understand business requirements, identify technical bottlenecks, and recommend practical improvements.



 
 AI-Assisted Engineering: Integrate AI and LLM tools into everyday engineering activities, using them to improve productivity while critically validating generated code, recommendations, and outputs.



 
 End-to-End Ownership: Take responsibility for assigned data domains and pipelines, proactively identifying risks and delivering improvements in reliability, data quality, performance, and cost.



 
 Continuous Improvement: Contribute to a culture of accountability and knowledge sharing, making pragmatic technical decisions and independently prioritizing work.



 
 First Six Months – Expected Milestones:



 
 First 30 Days: Understand the business context and marketing data pipelines, then independently deliver small, well-tested changes.



 
 By 90 Days: Own pipeline changes end to end, optimize SQL workloads, and proactively identify data quality or reliability risks.



 
 By 180 Days: Take ownership of an agreed data domain or set of pipelines and deliver a measurable improvement in reliability, data quality, performance, or cost.



 
 Success Measures: Delivery quality and autonomy, recurring incidents, data quality issues, and improvements in query execution and runtime costs. Baselines and targets will be agreed during onboarding.






 Requirements:


 
 Professional Experience: At least 5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.



 
 Advanced SQL: Strong SQL expertise, including complex transformations, query development, and performance optimization.



 
 Python Development: Strong Python skills and practical experience using the language in production data engineering environments.



 
 ETL/ELT Pipeline Engineering: Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting data ingestion and transformation workflows.



 
 Workflow Orchestration: Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable orchestration tools, such as Dagster.



 
 Production Engineering Practices: Practical knowledge of debugging, testing, version control, monitoring, and maintaining reliable production workflows.



 
 Cloud Data Technologies: Experience with AWS data services, particularly Athena or comparable technologies such as Redshift or Snowflake, as well as AWS Glue and S3.



 
 Data Processing Technologies: Familiarity with Apache Iceberg and distributed data-processing engines such as Trino, Presto, or Spark.



 
 Observability and Optimization: Understanding of observability practices and the ability to improve performance and manage costs in cloud-based data systems.



 
 AI and LLM Tools: Regular, practical use of AI/LLM tools in engineering workflows, combined with the ability to assess their outputs critically and ensure technical quality.



 
 Ownership and Problem-Solving: A proactive, accountable approach to work, with the ability to identify issues, solve problems independently, and drive continuous improvement.



 
 Communication and Collaboration: Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with analysts and engineers, share knowledge, and contribute to team success.



 
 Autonomy and Prioritization: Ability to work independently, organize competing priorities, and make pragmatic technical trade-offs.



 
 Preferred Industry Experience: Experience working in a mobile-app business is an advantage.



 
 Preferred Work Environment: Familiarity with startup culture and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, evolving environment.




 Benefits:


 
 Remote Work: Fully remote working arrangement.



 
 Healthcare Support: Company-provided compensation for medical expenses.



 
 AI and Technology Tools: AI subscription and access to additional tools to support engineering productivity.



 
 Paid Time Off: Flexible paid time off, including 21 days of annual leave and 10 public holidays.



 
 Collaborative Environment: Opportunity to work alongside experienced and motivated professionals in an innovative, collaborative setting.



 
 Employment Arrangement: Contractor engagement.



 
 Compensation: Salary or contract rate is not specified in the job description.
